findings.title: H4 consumed/run-progress association under geometry control
findings.current_interpretation: A broad positive H4 consumed/run-progress association with PATH_REMAINING target-first ordering was replicated historically, but independent predictive information from consumed is not established after frozen target/point-check geometry control.

observations.statement: Q3/Q4 found a replicated broad positive association between H4 consumed/run-progress state and PATH_REMAINING target-first ordering under the then-frozen research representation.
observations.representation: Historical Q3/Q4 07:00 research representation; Q3 controlled age/recent-MTF but not target/point-check geometry.

observations.statement: Later frozen geometry control found the primary consumed residual non-positive in both Discovery and Replication.
observations.representation: RQ-015 frozen geometry-null analysis controlling target/point-check geometry.

reconciliation.statement: The observations are not mutually exclusive. A broad association can remain real while disappearing as independent information after conditioning on geometry. Current authority preserves the historical association but forbids using consumed as an independent predictor.

findings.title: Exness-branded XAUUSDm historical Bid/Ask archive route
findings.current_interpretation: A machine-accessible Exness-branded XAUUSDm archive exposes 2015-2026 directories and a September 2022 full-month sample passed structural Bid/Ask validation. This closes sample acquisition availability, not multi-year continuity or exact equivalence to the current Exness Demo/MT5 server.

observations.statement: The live archive listing exposed XAUUSDm years 2015 through 2026 and the September 2022 monthly ZIP was downloadable from the Owner machine.
observations.representation: Runtime archive listing and downloaded external historical file.

observations.statement: The September 2022 CSV contained 2,377,326 ticks with millisecond UTC Timestamp, Bid and Ask; the full-month scan found zero symbol/source mismatches, Ask < Bid rows, non-finite prices, timestamp regressions, or consecutive exact duplicate rows.

reconciliation.statement: The earlier MT5 authorization and Dukascopy network failures remain true historical observations. The new route supersedes only the earlier conclusion that a locally usable real Bid/Ask historical acquisition path had not yet been closed.
